socialSecurity.title: Triply Robust Panel Estimators
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper studies estimation of causal effects in a panel data setting. We introduce a new estimator, the Triply Robust Panel (TROP) estimator, that combines  a flexible model for the potential outcomes based on a low‐rank factor structure on top of a two‐way‐fixed effect specification, with  unit weights intended to upweight units similar to the treated units and  time weights intended to upweight time periods close to the treated time periods. We study the performance of the estimator in a set of simulations designed to closely match several commonly studied real data sets. We find that there is substantial variation in the performance of the estimators across the settings considered. The proposed estimator outperforms Two‐Way‐Fixed‐Effect (TWFE) or Difference‐In‐Differences (DID), Synthetic Control (SC), Matrix Completion (MC) and Synthetic‐Difference‐In‐Differences (SDID) estimators. We investigate what features of the data generating process lead to this superior performance and assess the relative importance of the three components of the proposed estimator. We have two recommendations. Our preferred strategy is that researchers use simulations closely matched to the data they are interested in, along the lines discussed in this paper, to investigate which estimators work well in their particular setting. A simpler approach is to use more robust estimators such as SDID or the new TROP estimator, which we find to substantially outperform TWFE/

socialSecurity.abstractZh:
摘要
                  本文研究面板数据设定下因果效应的估计问题。我们提出了一种新的估计量——三重稳健面板（TROP）估计量，它将基于低秩因子结构叠加双向固定效应设定的潜在结果灵活模型，与旨在对与处理单元相似的单元进行向上加权的单元权重，以及旨在对接近处理时点的时间段进行向上加权的时间权重相结合。我们在一组被设计为紧密匹配若干常用真实数据集的模拟中研究了该估计量的表现。我们发现，在所考察的各种设定中，估计量的性能存在显著差异。相较于双向固定效应（TWFE）或双重差分（DID）、合成控制（SC）、矩阵补全（MC）以及合成双重差分（SDID）估计量，本文所提出的估计量表现更优。我们考察了数据生成过程中的哪些特征导致了这种优越表现，并评估了所提估计量三个组成部分的相对重要性。我们提出两条建议：我们更倾向的策略是，研究者应按照本文所讨论的方式，使用与其所关注的数据紧密匹配的模拟来考察在特定情境下哪些估计量表现良好。一种更简便的方法是采用更为稳健的估计量，如 SDID 或本文提出的 TROP 估计量，我们发现它们的表现显著优于 TWFE/

socialSecurity.title: Estimation of Heterogeneous Panel Data Models With Mixed Sampling Frequencies
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  This paper studies heterogeneous mixed‐frequency panel data models, focusing on linear specifications that allow heterogeneity in both aggregation weights and slope coefficients. To address potential correlations between the heterogeneity and the covariates, we first show that, under additional normalization conditions, the mean‐group estimator delivers consistent and asymptotically normal slope estimates but biased weights estimators. As an alternative, we propose a correlated random effects estimator using a generalized Mundlak specification. We further discuss the implementation of these two estimators when covariates are observed at substantially higher sampling frequencies. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to assess their finite‐sample properties. As an empirical illustration, we revisit the impact of temperature fluctuations on economic growth using the proposed framework.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 混合采样频率异质性面板数据模型的估计
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究异质性混合频率面板数据模型，重点关注允许聚合权重和斜率系数同时具有异质性的线性设定。为应对异质性与协变量之间潜在的相关性，我们首先证明，在额外归一化条件下，均值组估计量能够给出斜率系数的一致且渐近正态估计，但权重估计量存在偏差。作为替代方案，我们提出了一种基于广义Mundlak设定的相关随机效应估计量。进一步讨论了当协变量以显著更高的采样频率被观测时这两种估计量的实现问题。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估其有限样本性质。作为经验应用，我们利用所提框架重新考察了温度波动对经济增长的影响。

socialSecurity.title: A Demand Theory of the Price Level
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Heterogeneous agent incomplete markets models offer a new perspective on price and inflation determination. In contrast to complete markets, the price level is determined from the asset‐market clearing condition. Fiscal and monetary policy then jointly and uniquely determine the finite steady‐state price level and the inflation rate, including in a steady state in which the nominal interest rate is constant. Fiscal policy can determine the long‐run inflation rate for a fiscal rule which sets the growth rate of nominal government debt, whereas both fiscal and monetary policy determine the long‐run inflation rate under different tax rules.

socialSecurity.title: Make or Buy Decisions and Data Sharing
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Firms can share data to discover potential synergies between their data sets and algorithms, eventually leading to more efficient mergers and acquisitions (M&A) decisions. However, data sharing also modifies the competitive balance when firms do not merge, and a company may be reluctant to share data with potential rivals. Under general conditions, we show that firms benefit from (partially) sharing data. By doing so, they can merge conditionally based on high synergies. Compared to a laissez‐faire situation, the presence of a regulator allowing or refusing the M&A may increase or decrease data sharing, with a concomitant increase or decrease in consumer surplus. Hence, regulation can
                    reduce the surplus
                    of consumers it is willing to protect. We revisit the Google/Fitbit acquisition through the lens of this interplay between strategic data sharing and antitrust policy.

socialSecurity.title: Gender Criteria Gap in Evaluation: Role of Perceived Intentions and Outcomes
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    We investigate whether different criteria are used in evaluating male and female leaders when outcomes are determined by unobservable choices and luck. Evaluators form beliefs about leaders’ choices (perceived intentions) and make discretionary payments. We find that while payments to male leaders are determined by both outcomes and perceived intentions, those to female leaders are determined by outcomes only. We label this new source of gender bias as the
                    gender criteria gap
                    . Our findings imply that high outcomes are necessary for women to get bonuses, but men can receive bonuses for low outcomes if evaluators hold them in high regard.
socialSecurity.titleZh: Gender Criteria Gap in Evaluation: Role of Perceived Intentions and Outcomes

We assess the Brazilian Organizações Sociais de Saude model (OSS), which outsources management of public hospital services to the private sector while the state remains the residual claimant. We show that this enhances hospital production and operational efficiency without adverse effects on hospital quality and equity. Increased inpatient production addresses previously unmet demand, expanding local access to hospital c
socialSecurity.titleZh: 私人管理下的公共服务
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 理论预测，将公共服务外包给私营部门可以降低成本并提高效率，但也可能导致削减成本并损害质量。本文评估了巴西的卫生社会组织（Organizações Sociais de Saude, OSS）模式，该模式将公立医院服务的管理外包给私营部门，而州政府仍作为剩余索取权人。研究表明，这一模式提升了医院的产出和运营效率，且对医院质量与公平性没有产生不利影响。在院服务产出的增加满足了此前未被满足的需求，扩大了当地居民对医院服务的可及性。

In both cases, co-located teams experienced bigger changes in proximity than distributed ones, facilitating difference-in-differences designs. socialSecurity.titleZh: 同事邻近性的力量
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：同事之间的邻近性如何影响培训与生产力？本研究以2019至2024年间一家《财富》500强企业的软件工程师为研究对象，借助两次邻近性的外生冲击进行分析：2020年的办公室关闭事件，以及2022年和2023年相继实施的返岗办公政策。在两种情况下，集中办公团队所经历的邻近性变化均大于分布式团队，从而便于采用双重差分方法进行识别。研究发现，与团队成员相邻而坐可使编码反馈增加18.3%，并提升代码质量。这些收益主要集中于资历较浅和较年轻的员工群体——他们正处于建立人力资本的阶段。

socialSecurity.title: The Equilibrium Effects of Eviction Policies
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  I propose a dynamic equilibrium model of rental markets that endogenously gives rise to defaults on rents and evictions. In the model, eviction protections make it harder to evict delinquent renters, but higher default costs to landlords increase equilibrium rents. I quantify the model using micro data on evictions, rents, and homelessness. I find that stronger eviction protections exacerbate housing insecurity and lower welfare. The key empirical driver of this result is the persistent nature of risk underlying rent delinquencies. Rental assistance reduces housing insecurity and improves welfare because it lowers the likelihood that renters default ex ante.

socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：本文提出一个租金市场的动态均衡模型，该模型内生地产生了租金违约和驱逐现象。在模型中，驱逐保护使房东更难驱逐违约租户，但房东承担的更高违约成本会推高均衡租金水平。作者利用有关驱逐、租金和无家可归者的微观数据对模型进行了量化分析。研究发现，更强的驱逐保护会加剧住房不安全性并降低社会福利。这一结果的关键经验驱动力在于租金违约背后风险的持续性特征。租金援助能够降低住房不安全性并提高社会福利，因为它在事前降低了租户违约的可能性。

socialSecurity.title: The Interaction Between Credit and Labor Market Frictions
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  I study a novel two‐way feedback between credit and labor market frictions. Running from credit to labor markets, amplitude in capital demand caused by collateral constraints spills over onto labor demand due to the complementarity of capital and labor; and, furthermore, credit frictions raise effective financial hiring costs, prompting firms to delay hiring in recessions. Running back from labor to credit markets, search frictions imply that wages move less than one‐to‐one with productivity; this induces greater volatility of net worth, via the wage bill, which then spills over onto capital demand. Together, these considerably amplify labor and capital market dynamics.

socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究了信贷市场摩擦与劳动力市场摩擦之间一种新颖的双向反馈机制。从信贷市场向劳动力市场传导的路径来看：抵押品约束所引致的资本需求波动，由于资本与劳动之间的互补性，会溢出至劳动需求；此外，信贷摩擦提高了企业有效的金融雇佣成本，促使企业在经济衰退期延迟招聘决策。从劳动力市场向信贷市场反馈的路径来看：搜寻摩擦意味着工资变动幅度小于生产率的同比例变化；这通过工资成本渠道导致企业净资产波动加剧，进而溢出至资本需求。上述机制共同显著放大了劳动市场与资本市场的动态波动。

socialSecurity.title: Learning in the Limit: Income Inference from Credit Extensions
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Combining a randomized controlled trial with administrative and survey data, this paper shows that credit limit extensions significantly increase total spending and income expectations. By controlling for changes in personal income expectations, the spending response to credit limit extensions weakens by approximately 30%. For financially unconstrained consumers, expectation changes account for around two‐thirds of the spending responses to limit extensions. These findings are consistent with consumers inferring future income from credit supply.

socialSecurity.title: The Decentralization of Liquor Policies in Texas During the Post‐Prohibition Era
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We examine the decentralization of liquor policies in Texas during the Post‐Prohibition era using newly collected historical legislative roll call data. By combining these data with local referendum vote shares, we analyze both legislators' and constituents' preferences on liquor policy. We develop a probabilistic voting model incorporating spillovers and peer effects. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity in preferences among voters, reflecting differing attitudes toward alcohol regulation. Spillover effects are significant, yet the model predicts notable gains from decentralization. Finally, we link legislators' policy preferences to alcohol consumption data and compare model‐based welfare estimates with traditional consumption‐based measures.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 禁酒令后时代德克萨斯州酒类政策的分权化
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文利用新收集的历史立法点名投票数据，研究了禁酒令后时代德克萨斯州酒类政策的分权化。通过将这些数据与地方公投得票率相结合，我们分析了立法者与选民在酒类政策上的偏好。我们构建了一个包含溢出效应和同侪效应的概率投票模型。结果显示，选民偏好存在显著异质性，反映出他们对酒类监管的态度差异。溢出效应显著，但模型预测分权化将带来显著收益。最后，我们将立法者的政策偏好与酒精消费数据相联系，并将基于模型的福利估计与传统基于消费的衡量方法进行了比较。

socialSecurity.title: Labor Market Monopsony Power and the Dynamic Gains to Openness Reforms
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We embed labor market monopsony into a dynamic heterogeneous‐firm general equilibrium model with exporting, horizontal FDI, and rich firm lifecycle dynamics. Rising marginal costs with monopsony slow and limit incumbent firm growth in response to liberalization, shifting adjustment to the extensive margin. Calibrated to US micro data, welfare gains from tariff reduction are over four times larger under monopsony than with perfect labor markets. The difference is mostly driven by new exporter creation and firm entry along the transition path. By contrast, lowering outward FDI taxes gives powerful quantitative welfare losses under monopsony, as firms undertake FDI to escape domestic wage pressure.

socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：研究企业活力的一个关键问题是，监管合规成本是否在小型企业和大型企业之间均匀分布。利用全面的机构层面职业微观数据与职业任务信息，我们将企业的合规成本量化为执行监管合规任务所支付的工资份额（RegIndex）。我们揭示了企业RegIndex与其规模之间存在倒U型关系：平均而言，约500名员工的中小型企业的RegIndex比最小企业高约47%，比大型企业高约18%……

socialSecurity.title: Smokestacks and the Swamp
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe examine whether politicians affect local firms’ industrial pollution, and whether such effects are transmitted through plant-level networks to affect pollution in other regions. We first document that close Democrat wins in U.S. congressional races are associated with lower emissions and higher abatement at the plant level, especially when politicians have strong pro-environmental preferences. We also find evidence of reallocation: firms shift emissions away from areas represented by Democrats. However, reallocation is imperfect: firm-level costs are higher and market-to-book ratios
socialSecurity.titleZh: 烟囱与沼泽
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要 本文考察政治家是否会影响本地企业的工业污染，以及这种影响是否会通过工厂层面的网络传导进而影响其他地区的污染。我们首先记录了以下事实：在美国国会选举中，民主党候选人的微弱胜出与工厂层面更低的排放量和更高的污染治理水平相关，尤其当这些政治家具有强烈的环境偏好时效应更为显著。我们还发现了污染再分配的证据：企业将排放从民主党代表的地区转移出去。然而，再分配并不完全：企业层面的成本更高，市净率也更低。

socialSecurity.title: The Short and the Long of It: Stock‐Flow Matching in the US Housing Market
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  From 2006 until 2020, the probability of selling a house in the U.S. declined sharply after listing for 2 weeks. Moreover, sales within the first 2 weeks of listing (“quick sales”) and sales happening afterward (“slow sales”) behaved differently over the housing cycle. The probability and associated price of a quick sale recovered from the slump sooner, faster, and more prominently than a slow sale. This paper demonstrates that a calibrated stock‐flow matching model not only generates quantitatively consistent sales, prices, listings, and time on the market but also captures distinctions between fast and slow sales over the housing cycle.
socialSecurity.titleZh: The Short and the Long of It: Stock‐Flow Matching in the US Housing Market

socialSecurity.title: The Effects of Mandatory Profit-Sharing on Workers and Firms: Evidence from France
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractSince 1967, all French firms with more than 100 employees have been required to share a fraction of their excess profits with their employees. Through this scheme, firms with excess profits distribute, on average, 10.5% of their pretax income to workers. In 1990, the eligibility threshold was reduced to 50 employees. We exploit this regulatory change to identify the effects of mandated profit-sharing on firms and their employees. The cost of mandated profit-sharing for firms is evident in the significant bunching at the 100-employee threshold observed prior to the reform, which complet
socialSecurity.titleZh: 强制性利润分享对工人和企业的影响：来自法国的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 自1967年以来，所有员工人数超过100人的法国企业都被要求将一部分超额利润分配给员工。通过该方案，拥有超额利润的企业平均将税前收入的10.5%分配给工人。1990年，资格门槛被降低至50名员工。我们利用这一监管变化来识别强制性利润分享对企业和员工的影响。强制性利润分享对企业的成本在改革前观察到的100名员工门槛处的显著聚集中显而易见，该

socialSecurity.title: “Immigration, Search and Redistribution: A Quantitative Assessment of Native Welfare” A Reply
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractStark and Byra identify a mistake in how capital income is calculated in the supplementary files of Battisti et al. and point out that our wage bargaining equation does not correspond to the Nash bargaining solution in the presence of wage taxation. We acknowledge both points and thank the authors for pointing out these issues. The bargaining solution we use in Battisti et al. is the Kalai proportional bargaining solution with fixed surplus shares, not Nash bargaining. In our reply, we show that if we calibrate the model to wage tax rates, correcting the coding mistake has only a minor
socialSecurity.source: Journal of the European Economic Association
socialSecurity.titleZh: 移民、搜寻与再分配：本土居民福利的定量评估——回复
socialSecurity.abstractZh: Stark和Byra指出了Battisti等人补充文件中资本收入计算方式的一个错误，并指出我们的工资议价方程在存在工资税的情况下与纳什议价解不一致。我们承认这两点，并感谢作者指出这些问题。我们在Battisti等人中所采用的议价解是具有固定剩余份额的Kalai比例议价解，而非纳什议价解。在本回复中，我们展示了若按工资税率对模型进行重新校准，纠正上述编码错误仅会产生轻微的……

socialSecurity.title: How Does Progressivity Affect the Tax Cut Multiplier?
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  How does the targeting of personal income tax cuts affect the output multiplier? This paper provides quantitative evidence using a heterogeneous‐agent New‐Keynesian model calibrated to match US distributions of income, wealth, marginal tax rates, and marginal propensities to consume. Labor supply is determined by household preferences on the intensive margin and search frictions on the extensive margin. The model evaluates tax cuts for the bottom‐90 (B90%) and top‐10% of the income distribution in national and cross‐region settings, replicating influential empirical research designs. B90 tax cuts generate larger output effects while incentive effects play a central role in transmission.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 累进性如何影响减税乘数？
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 《国际经济评论》，在线优先出版。

socialSecurity.title: Place‐Based Land Policy and Spatial Misallocation: Theory and Evidence From China
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We investigate a land policy in China that allocated more urban land quotas to underdeveloped regions to reduce regional gaps. Empirically, the policy decreased productivity in eastern areas relative to the inland. A spatial equilibrium model with migration, land quota constraints, and agglomeration shows the policy distorts labor and production across regions, causing substantial output losses. Though regional gaps narrowed, workers from underdeveloped areas migrated less and earned less. Without the policy, national output would have been 1.8% higher, and workers in underdeveloped areas would have earned 1.6% more in 2010. Regional transfers offer a less distortionary alternative for reducing inequality.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 基于区域的土地政策与空间错配：理论与来自中国的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究中国的一项土地政策，该政策将更多城市土地配额分配给欠发达地区以缩小区域差距。实证上，该政策降低了东部地区相对于内陆地区的生产率。一个包含迁移、土地配额约束和集聚的空间均衡模型表明，该政策扭曲了跨区域的劳动力和生产，造成了巨大的产出损失。尽管区域差距有所收窄，但来自欠发达地区的工人迁移减少，收入也更低。在没有该政策的情况下，2010年国家产出将提高1.8%，欠发达地区工人的收入将增加1.6%。区域转移支付是缩小不平等的一种扭曲性更小的替代方案。

socialSecurity.title: Collusion with Optimal Information Disclosure*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractMotivated by recent concerns surrounding the use of third-party pricing algorithms by competing firms, we study repeated Bertrand competition where market demand or the cost of serving the market is observed by an intermediary (or “algorithm”) that selectively discloses demand or cost information to maximize firms’ collusive profit. We show that an upper censorship disclosure policy is optimal, which leads to price rigidity and supra-monopoly prices in some states. Improving the algorithm’s accuracy reduces expected consumer surplus whenever it does so under monopoly pricing. When the
socialSecurity.titleZh: 最优信息披露下的合谋
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：受近期对竞争企业使用第三方定价算法的关注所启发，本文研究重复的伯川德竞争模型，其中市场需求或服务市场的成本由中介（或“算法”）观察，该中介选择性地披露需求或成本信息以最大化企业的合谋利润。我们证明，上限审查披露政策是最优的，其在某些状态下会导致价格刚性和超垄断价格。提升算法的准确性会在垄断定价下降低预期消费者剩余。当算法在合谋定价下不影响消费者剩余时，算法准确性的提升在所有情形下都会降低预期消费者剩余。

socialSecurity.title: Codification, Technology Absorption, and the Globalization of the Industrial Revolution
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis article examines the global adoption of technology in the late nineteenth century. We construct several novel data sets to test the idea that the codification of technical knowledge in the vernacular was necessary for countries to absorb the technologies of the first Industrial Revolution. We find that comparative advantage shifted to industries that could benefit from these technologies in countries and colonies with access to codified technical knowledge, but not in other regions. Using the rapid and unprecedented codification of technical knowledge in Meiji Japan as a natural e
socialSecurity.titleZh: 技术编码化、技术吸收与工业革命的全球化
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文考察了十九世纪末技术的全球传播。作者构建了若干新颖的数据集，以检验将技术知识以本国语言进行编码化是否为一国吸收工业革命技术的必要条件。研究发现，在能够获取编码化技术知识的国家和殖民地，比较优势向能够受益于这些技术的产业转移，而在其他地区则未出现此现象。本文以明治日本快速且史无前例的技术知识编码化作为自然实验

socialSecurity.title: “Compensate the Losers?” Economic Policy and the Origins of U.S. Partisan Realignment*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe argue that the Democratic Party’s evolution on economic policy helps explain partisan realignment by education. First, we document that educated Americans differentially oppose “predistribution” (e.g., job guarantees, higher minimum wages, protectionism, and stronger unions), while the educational gradient for redistribution (taxes and transfers) is close to zero. These relationships have been largely unchanged since the 1940s. Second, focusing on politicians and donors as key party actors, we show that the Democratic Party has moved away from predistribution since the 1970s. The nu
socialSecurity.titleZh: "补偿输家"？经济政策与美国政党重组的起源
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们认为，民主党在经济政策上的演变有助于解释按教育程度划分的政党重组。首先，我们记录了受教育的美国人对"预分配"政策（例如就业保障、提高最低工资、贸易保护主义和加强工会）存在差异化的反对态度，而再分配（税收与转移支付）的教育梯度则接近于零。这些关系自20世纪40年代以来大体上未发生变化。其次，以政治人物和捐赠者作为关键的政党行动者，我们表明自20世纪70年代以来民主党已逐渐远离预分配政策。

socialSecurity.title: Accounting for the Evolution of China's Production and Trade Patterns
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We study the evolution of China's production and trade patterns during its integration into the global economy. Using firm‐level microdata, we document how production and exports shifted across industries and within industries across firms. We quantify a Ricardian–Heckscher–Ohlin model with heterogeneous firms to account for these changes. Counterfactuals show capital deepening pushed China's production and exports toward greater capital intensity, while labor‐biased productivity growth provided an offsetting force. The model generates an inverted‐U pattern in China's trade openness—peaking in the mid‐2000s and declining through the 2020s—alongside a continuous rise in the world's exposure to Chinese exports.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 中国生产与贸易格局演变的解释
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究中国融入全球经济过程中生产与贸易格局的演变。利用企业层面的微观数据，本文记录了生产与出口在行业之间以及行业内企业之间的转移。本文通过量化一个具有企业异质性的李嘉图—赫克歇尔—俄林模型来解释这些变化。反事实分析表明，资本深化推动中国的生产和出口向更高的资本密集度方向转变，而劳动偏向型生产率增长则提供了抵消力量。该模型生成的中国贸易开放度呈倒U型模式——在2000年代中期达到峰值，并在2020年代之前持续下降——同时全球对中国出口的敞口则持续上升。

socialSecurity.title: The Effects of Gender Integration on Men: Evidence from the U.S. Military
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractDo men negatively respond when women first enter an occupation? We answer this question by studying the end of one of the final explicit occupational barriers to women in the United States: in 2016, the U.S. military opened all positions to women, including historically male-only combat occupations. We exploit the staggered integration of women into combat units to estimate the causal effects of the introduction of female colleagues on men’s job performance, behavior, and perceptions of workplace quality, using monthly administrative personnel records and rich survey responses. We find
socialSecurity.titleZh: 性别整合对男性的影响：来自美国军队的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：当女性首次进入某一职业时，男性是否会作出消极反应？我们以美国最后一个对女性设有明确职业准入壁垒的领域之一为研究对象来回答这一问题：2016年，美国军队向女性开放了所有岗位，包括历史上仅限男性从事的战斗类职业。我们利用女性分阶段进入战斗部队这一准实验设计，借助月度行政人事记录和丰富的调查数据，估计女性同事的引入对男性工作绩效、行为以及工作场所质量评价的因果效应。研究发现

socialSecurity.title: Do Parents Propagate Inequality Among Children? Evidence From Chinese and Swedish Twins
socialSecurity.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Economists have long studied how parental behavior shapes within‐family inequality, yet empirical findings remain mixed. Using twins data from China and Sweden, we examine the predominant mechanisms reported in the literature. Parents in both countries invest similarly during childhood. Inter vivos transfers, however, differ: Chinese parents reinforce income inequality, whereas Swedish parents distribute wealth equally; the reinforcing pattern reflects exchange motives. Bequests are divided equally in both countries. Parental education plays a key role: less educated parents reinforce income inequality, whereas more educated parents transfer wealth equally. Cross‐country differences in parental education may thus help explain the mixed findings.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 父母是否在子女间传递不平等？来自中国与瑞典双胞胎的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 《国际经济评论》，在线先发表。

socialSecurity.title: Making the Invisible Hand Visible: Managers and the Allocation of Workers to Jobs*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWhy do managers matter for firm performance? This article provides evidence of the critical role of managers in matching workers to jobs within the firm using the universe of personnel records from a large multinational firm. The data cover 200,000 white-collar workers and 30,000 managers over 11 years in 100 countries. I identify good managers by their speed of promotion and leverage exogenous variation induced by the rotation of managers across teams. I find that good managers cause workers to reallocate within the firm through lateral and vertical transfers and generate large and pe
socialSecurity.titleZh: 让看不见的手可见：管理者与工人的岗位分配
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：为什么管理者对企业绩效至关重要？本文利用一家大型跨国公司全体员工的人事记录数据，提供了管理者在企业内实现人岗匹配关键作用的证据。数据涵盖100个国家、11年间20万名白领员工和3万名管理者。本文通过管理者的晋升速度来识别优秀管理者，并利用管理者在团队间轮岗所带来的外生变异进行识别。研究发现，优秀管理者会促使员工通过横向和纵向调岗在企业内重新配置，并产生显著且持久的影响。

socialSecurity.title: Technology Sophistication Across Establishments*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe study technology sophistication using a novel approach that measures the sophistication of the most advanced (MAX) and the most widely used (MOST) technologies in key business functions within establishments. Using data from over 21,000 establishments across 15 countries, we find that establishments generally underutilize the most sophisticated technologies available in a business function. These MAX-MOST gaps are persistent and strongly associated with productivity both across establishments and countries. At the establishment level, there is substantial variation in both MAX and M
socialSecurity.titleZh: 企业间的技术成熟度
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们采用一种新方法研究技术成熟度，该方法通过衡量企业在关键业务功能中所使用的最先进技术（MAX）和最广泛使用技术（MOST）的成熟度。基于来自15个国家超过21,000家企业的数据，我们发现企业在业务功能中普遍未能充分利用现有最成熟的技术。这些MAX与MOST之间的差距具有持续性，并与企业和国家层面的生产率密切相关。在企业层面，MAX和MOST都存在显著差异。

socialSecurity.title: Diet, Economic Development and Climate Change
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe develop a quantitative, multi-country general equilibrium framework to study the impact of economic growth, dietary restrictions and food trade policies on global greenhouse-gas (GHG) emissions from agriculture. Motivated by new cross-country relationships between economic development, diet patterns, agricultural technologies and GHG emissions, our framework features different income elasticities of demand across food products and multiple agricultural technologies for production across grid cells covering the surface of the Earth, with food products and technologies being heterogen
socialSecurity.titleZh: 饮食、经济发展与气候变化
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们构建了一个量化的多国一般均衡框架，用以研究经济增长、饮食限制以及食品贸易政策对农业全球温室气体（GHG）排放的影响。基于经济发展、饮食模式、农业技术与温室气体排放之间新的跨国关联关系，该框架在覆盖地球表面的网格单元上，针对不同食品产品设定差异化的需求收入弹性，并包含多种农业生产技术，其中食品产品与技术均具有异质性。

socialSecurity.title: Non-compete agreements and labor allocation across product markets
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractI analyze the effect of non-compete agreements (NCAs) on the allocation of inventors across product markets. NCAs constrain the within-industry employment choice set of inventors. In a staggered difference-in-differences, I show causal effects that two in hundred inventors per year (increase of 42 percent) respond to more enforceable NCAs by moving to more distant product markets. Across-industry mobility is largest for inventors likely bound by NCAs. Within-industry mobility on the other hand is reduced. Reallocated inventors are subsequently less productive and there is a lower quali
socialSecurity.titleZh: 竞业禁止协议与产品市场间的劳动力配置
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文分析竞业禁止协议（NCA）对发明人在不同产品市场间配置的影响。竞业禁止协议限制了发明人在行业内的可选就业范围。通过交错双重差分法，本文揭示了因果效应：每两百名发明人中约有两人（增幅为42%）会因竞业禁止协议可执行性增强而迁移到距离更远的产品市场。跨行业流动性在极可能受竞业禁止协议约束的发明人中最为显著，而行业内的流动性则有所下降。被重新配置的发明人其后续产出率降低，且专利质量也较低

socialSecurity.title: Competition, complexity, and security design: evidence from retail investment products
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe investigate the role of strategic security design in the market for retail investment products. Focusing on a dominant yet understudied design feature, we provide evidence consistent with issuers’ strategic increase of product complexity to mitigate price competition. Complexity facilitates product differentiation, thereby impairing investors’ ability to compare products. Because more complex products entail greater markups, imply higher tail risk, and are first-order stochastically dominated by simpler products, the empirically observed rise in market complexity increases uncompens
socialSecurity.titleZh: 竞争、复杂性与证券设计：来自零售投资产品的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究零售投资产品市场中战略性证券设计的作用。我们聚焦于一种占主导地位但研究不足的设计特征，提供了与发行人为缓解价格竞争而战略性提高产品复杂性相一致的证据。复杂性有助于产品差异化，从而削弱投资者比较产品的能力。由于更复杂的产品具有更高的加价、蕴含更大的尾部风险，并且被更简单的产品一阶随机占优，实证观察到的市场复杂性上升增加了未得到补偿的风险。

socialSecurity.title: Carbon Pricing and Inequality: A Normative Perspective
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractDespite broad acceptance among economists, carbon taxes face persistent public resistance. We measure the sources and distribution of welfare losses from unexpected European carbon price changes by estimating their impact on consumer prices, labour income, financial wealth and government transfers. A 1% carbon-policy-induced increase in energy prices leads to an average welfare loss of about 0.5% of a household’s three-year consumption, primarily driven by indirect labour-income effects. Younger, poorer and less educated households, especially in Southern and Eastern Europe, bear a dis
socialSecurity.titleZh: 碳定价与不平等：一种规范性视角
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要 尽管碳税在经济学家中获得了广泛认同，却始终面临公众的持续抵制。我们通过估算欧洲意外碳价变化对消费品价格、劳动收入、金融财富以及政府转移支付的影响，来衡量福利损失的来源及其分布。一次由碳政策引致的1%的能源价格上涨，会导致家庭三年消费平均约0.5%的福利损失，主要源于间接的劳动收入效应。年轻、贫困、受教育程度较低的家庭，尤其是南欧和东欧的家庭，承受了不成比例的负面影响。

socialSecurity.title: Peer Effects and the Gender Gap in Corporate Leadership: Evidence from MBA Students*
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWomen continue to be underrepresented in corporate leadership positions. This article studies the role of social connections in women’s career advancement. We investigate whether access to a larger share of female peers in business school affects the gender gap in senior managerial positions. Merging administrative data from a top 10 U.S. business school with public LinkedIn profiles, we first document that female MBAs are 24% less likely than male MBAs to enter senior management within 15 years of graduation. Next we use the exogenous assignment of students into sections to show that
socialSecurity.titleZh: 同伴效应与企业领导力中的性别差距：来自MBA学生的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 女性在企业领导岗位中仍然代表性不足。本文研究社会关系在女性职业晋升中的作用。我们考察商学院中女性同伴比例的提高是否会影响高级管理岗位中的性别差距。通过将美国一所排名前10的商学院的管理数据与公开的领英个人档案进行合并，我们首先发现女性MBA毕业生在毕业后15年内进入高级管理岗位的可能性比男性MBA毕业生低24%。接下来，我们利用学生被外生地分配到不同班级的做法，表明……

socialSecurity.title: The Winners and Losers of Climate Policies: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractTo combat global warming, climate policies like carbon taxes, renewable subsidies and carbon tariffs must be implemented to phase out fossil fuel consumption and lower emissions. Who are the winners and losers of such policies? Through a simple integrated assessment model with heterogeneous countries and international trade in goods and energy, we study both the costs of implementing these policies unilaterally and the local costs and global gains of international policy cooperation. To do so, we express and decompose welfare changes under different policy regimes to the first order as
socialSecurity.titleZh: 气候政策的赢家与输家：一种充分统计量方法
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 为了应对全球变暖，必须实施碳税、可再生能源补贴和碳关税等气候政策，以逐步淘汰化石燃料消费并降低排放。这些政策的赢家与输家是谁？通过一个包含异质性国家和国际商品与能源贸易的简单综合评估模型，我们研究了单方面实施这些政策的成本，以及国际政策合作的局部成本与全球收益。为此，我们在一阶近似下表达并分解了不同政策制度下的福利变化

socialSecurity.title: Selection in Surveys: Using Randomized Incentives to Detect and Account for Nonresponse Bias
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe show how to use randomized participation incentives to test and account for nonresponse bias in surveys. We first use data from a survey about labour market conditions, linked to full-population administrative data, to provide evidence of large differences in labour market outcomes between survey participants and nonparticipants, differences which would not be observable to an analyst who only has access to the survey data. These differences persist even after correcting for observable characteristics. We then use the randomized incentives in our survey to directly test for nonrespo
socialSecurity.titleZh: 调查中的选择偏差：使用随机激励检测并校正无回答偏差
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们展示了如何利用随机化的参与激励来检验和校正调查中的无回答偏差。首先，我们使用一项关于劳动力市场状况的调查数据（与覆盖全人口行政数据相链接），以提供证据表明调查参与者与非参与者在劳动力市场结果方面存在显著差异，而这些差异对于仅能获取调查数据的分析者来说是不可见的。即使在根据可观测特征进行校正后，这些差异依然存在。随后，我们利用调查中的随机激励设计，直接检验无回答...

socialSecurity.title: Latent Heterogeneity in the Marginal Propensity to Consume
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe estimate the unconditional distribution of the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) using clustering regression applied to the 2008 economic stimulus payments. By deviating from the standard approach of estimating MPC heterogeneity using interactions with observables, we can recover the full distribution of MPCs. We find households spent between 4 and 133% of the rebate within a quarter, and individual households used rebates for different goods. While many observable characteristics correlate individually with our estimated MPCs, most of these relationships disappear when tested jo
socialSecurity.titleZh: 边际消费倾向的潜在异质性
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们使用聚类回归方法，基于2008年经济刺激支付数据，估计了边际消费倾向（MPC）的无条件分布。通过偏离使用可观测变量交互项来估计MPC异质性的标准方法，我们能够恢复MPC的完整分布。我们发现，家庭在一个季度内将退税的4%至133%用于消费，且不同家庭将退税用于不同的商品。虽然许多可观测特征单独与我们估计的MPC相关，但当联合检验时，这些关系大多消失……

socialSecurity.title: Education and the Margins of Cyclical Adjustment in the Labour Market
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractAllocative wages—the labour costs considered when deciding to form or dissolve a long-term employment relationship—are more sensitive to cyclical conditions for more educated workers. Specifically, college-educated workers’ allocative wages are highly pro-cyclical, while high school dropouts’ wages exhibit only moderate cyclicality. Further, as education increases, an increasing share of the sensitivity of allocative wages is driven by the persistent scarring effects of the cyclical position at the time of hiring on the wages associated with higher levels of tenure, amounting to more t
socialSecurity.titleZh: 教育与劳动力市场周期性调整的边际
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 配置性工资——即在决定建立或解除长期雇佣关系时所考虑的劳动力成本——对受教育程度较高的劳动者而言对经济周期更为敏感。具体而言，受过大学教育的劳动者的配置性工资具有高度顺周期性，而高中辍学者的工资仅表现出中等程度的周期性。此外，随着教育水平的提高，配置性工资敏感性中越来越大的部分来自于入职时周期性状况对与较长任期相关工资的持续性创伤效应，这一比例在长期中相当显著。

socialSecurity.title: A Macro Study of the Unequal Effects of Climate Change
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis paper develops a macro heterogeneous-agent model to quantify the distributional impacts of higher temperatures resulting from climate change in the United States. Households adapt to temperature through two channels: an intensive margin—adjusting energy use for heating and cooling—and an extensive margin—deciding whether to purchase temperature-control equipment such as a heater, air conditioner or heat pump. I estimate the production functions for household heating and cooling from a unique product-level data set and calibrate the remaining parameters to match variation in energy
socialSecurity.titleZh: 气候变化不平等效应的宏观研究
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个宏观异质性主体模型，以量化美国气温升高（由气候变化导致）所产生的分配性影响。家庭通过两个渠道对气温变化做出适应：集约边际——调整用于供暖和制冷的能源使用；以及广延边际——决定是否购买温控设备，如暖气、空调或热泵。作者利用一组独特的产品层面数据估计了家庭供暖与制冷的生产函数，并对其余参数进行了校准，以匹配能源使用方面的变化。

socialSecurity.title: ESG Shocks in Global Supply Chains
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe show that U.S. firms cut imports by 31.8% when their international suppliers experience environmental and social (E&S) incidents. These trade cuts are larger for publicly listed U.S. importers facing high E&S investor pressure and lead to cross-country supplier reallocation, suggesting that E&S preferences in capital markets can be privately costly but have real effects for foreign suppliers. Larger trade cuts around the incident result in better supplier E&S performance in subsequent years and in the eventual resumption of trade. Our results highlight the role of investors in ensur
socialSecurity.titleZh: 全球供应链中的环境、社会与治理冲击
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究表明，当国际供应商发生环境与社会（E&S）事件时，美国企业会将其进口削减31.8%。对于面临较高E&S投资者压力的美国上市进口企业而言，这种贸易削减幅度更大，并导致跨国供应商的重新配置，这表明资本市场中的E&S偏好虽然可能带来私人的成本代价，但对外国供应商具有实质性的影响。事件发生前后更大规模的贸易削减会带来供应商后续年份更好的E&S表现，并最终促使贸易恢复。我们的研究结果凸显了投资者在确保（全球供应链环境与社会责任）方面的作用。

socialSecurity.title: Patent Term, Innovation, and the Role of Technology Disclosure Externalities
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractI examine the impact of patent term on R&D and innovation in the presence of policy anticipation, common in real-world settings. Using a difference-in-difference design, I exploit quasi-experimental variation in US patent term across technological fields due to the ratification of TRIPs agreements in 1995. Despite a general increase in average patent term, in most fields innovators faced a considerable probability of patent term reduction for future innovations. Three key findings emerge: (1) R&D and innovation accelerate more in fields with a higher probability of patent term reductio
socialSecurity.titleZh: 专利期限、创新与技术披露外部性的作用
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：本文在政策预期普遍存在的现实背景下，考察专利期限对研发与创新的影响。本文采用双重差分设计，利用1995年《与贸易有关的知识产权协定》（TRIPs）批准后美国各技术领域专利期限的准实验变异。尽管平均专利期限整体上升，但大多数领域的创新者所面临的未来创新专利期限被大幅缩短的概率仍然较高。研究得出三项主要发现：（1）专利期限被缩短概率较高的领域，研发与创新增速更快；（2）……（摘要截断）

socialSecurity.title: The Illiquidity of Water Markets
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe investigate the efficiency of a market relative to a non-market institution—an auction relative to a quota—as allocation mechanisms in the presence of frictions. We use data from water markets in southeastern Spain and explore a specific change in the institutions to allocate water. On the one hand, frictions arose because poor farmers were liquidity constrained. On the other hand, farmers who were part of the wealthy elite were not liquidity constrained. We estimate a structural dynamic demand model by taking advantage of the fact that water demand for both types of farmers is dete
socialSecurity.titleZh: 水市场的非流动性
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们研究了在存在摩擦的条件下，作为配置机制的市场（拍卖）相对于非市场制度（配额）的效率。我们利用西班牙东南部水市场的数据，探讨了水分配制度的一次特定变革。一方面，摩擦的产生源于贫困农民面临流动性约束；另一方面，属于富裕精英阶层的农民则不存在流动性约束。我们利用两类农民对水的需求在给定制度和价格条件下具有确定性这一事实，估计了一个结构性动态需求模型。

socialSecurity.title: Optimal Fiscal Policy in a Climate-Economy Model with Heterogeneous Households
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe study optimal fiscal policy to address climate change and inequality. We theoretically characterise optimal carbon and income taxes and quantify them for the US economy using a climate model calibrated to DICE. In contrast to the representative-agent setting, we find that (i) tax distortions have a negligible effect on the optimal carbon tax; (ii) inequality only slightly reduces it; (iii) the revenue from carbon taxes is optimally split about equally between reducing tax distortions and increasing transfers. Unlike the double-dividend policy, optimal carbon taxation has progressive
socialSecurity.titleZh: 异质性家庭气候经济模型中的最优财政政策
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们研究应对气候变化和不平等的最优财政政策。我们从理论上刻画了最优碳税和所得税，并使用与DICE校准一致的气候模型对美国经济进行量化分析。与代表性主体设定不同，我们发现：(i) 税收扭曲对最优碳税的影响可忽略不计；(ii) 不平等仅略微降低最优碳税；(iii) 碳税收入在减少税收扭曲和增加转移支付之间大致平均分配。与双重红利政策不同，最优碳税具有累进性。

socialSecurity.title: The Macroeconomics of Irreversibility
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe study aggregate capital dynamics in an investment model with idiosyncratic productivity shocks, fixed capital adjustment costs, and irreversibility driven by a wedge between capital purchase and resale prices. We derive sufficient statistics that capture the role of investment frictions in aggregate capital fluctuations, measure these statistics using investment microdata, and exploit them to discipline the capital price wedge. Irreversibility doubles the persistence of capital fluctuations and is crucial for reconciling micro-level investment behaviour with macroeconomic propagatio
socialSecurity.titleZh: 不可逆性的宏观经济学
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文在一个包含异质性生产率冲击、固定资本调整成本以及由资本购买价格与转售价格之间楔子所驱动的不可逆性的投资模型中，研究了总资本动态。我们推导出能够刻画投资摩擦在总资本波动中作用的充分统计量，利用投资微观数据对这些统计量进行度量，并借助它们来约束资本价格楔子。结果表明，不可逆性使资本波动的持续性翻倍，并且对于调和微观层面的投资行为与宏观经济传导机制至关重要。

socialSecurity.title: The Unequal Costs of Carbon Pricing: Economic and Political Effects Across European Regions
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis paper examines the economic and political effects of carbon pricing across European regions. Our main finding is that a well-identified increase in carbon prices reduces emissions, but entails economic and political costs: higher carbon prices significantly reduce output and employment while increasing vote shares for extremist and populist parties, contributing to political fragmentation. Consistent with an economic voting channel, opinion surveys reveal a more pessimistic economic outlook and declining environmental concerns among respondents. Importantly, the economic and polit
socialSecurity.titleZh: 碳定价的不平等代价：欧洲各地区的经济与政治影响
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文考察了碳定价对欧洲各地区的经济与政治影响。核心发现是，碳价格的显著提高虽然减少了排放，却带来了经济和政治代价：碳价格上升显著降低了产出和就业，同时提高了极端主义和民粹主义政党的得票率，加剧了政治碎片化。与经济投票机制相一致，意见调查显示受访者对经济前景更为悲观，环境关切也在下降。重要的是，经济和政治……（摘要截断）

socialSecurity.title: Distributional Consequences of Becoming Climate-Neutral
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThe EU has embarked on an ambitious path towards climate neutrality. How difficult will this transition be for the population as a whole and for different subsets of consumers? This paper investigates this question using a dynamic general-equilibrium model that captures a key feature of energy consumption: the relative energy content of one’s consumption basket falls significantly as a function of one’s relative income. Thus, low-income consumers are expected to be hit harder by the higher energy prices that we anticipate over the next few decades. In the model, energy—a complementary
socialSecurity.titleZh: 实现气候中和的分配后果
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：欧盟已踏上雄心勃勃的气候中和之路。这一转型对全体人口及不同消费者群体而言将有多大的困难？本文运用动态一般均衡模型对这一问题展开研究，该模型捕捉了能源消费的一个关键特征：消费篮子的相对能源含量随相对收入的提高而显著下降。因此，可以预见，未来几十年能源价格上行将对低收入消费者造成更为严重的冲击。在模型中，能源——作为一种互补品……

socialSecurity.title: Coordination and Sophistication
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractHow coordination can be achieved in isolated, one-shot interactions without communication and in the absence of focal points is a long-standing question in game theory. We show that a cost–benefit approach to reasoning in strategic settings delivers sharp theoretical predictions that address this central question. In particular, our model predicts that, for a large class of individual reasoning processes, coordination in some canonical games is more likely to arise when players perceive heterogeneity in their cognitive abilities, rather than homogeneity. In addition, and perhaps contra
socialSecurity.source: Journal of the European Economic Association
socialSecurity.titleZh: 协调与策略精炼
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要 在缺乏沟通且不存在焦点的孤立一次性互动中如何实现协调，是博弈论中长期存在的一个问题。本文表明，在策略情境中采用成本—收益推理方法能够得出精确的理论预测，从而回答这一核心问题。具体而言，我们的模型预测，在一大类个体推理过程中，当玩家感知到彼此认知能力的异质性而非同质性时，某些经典博弈中更有可能产生协调。此外，或许与直觉相悖……

socialSecurity.title: Markups Across Space and Time
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractIn this article, we provide direct evidence on the behaviour of markups in the retail sector across space and time. Markups are measured using gross margins. We consider three levels of aggregation: the retail sector as a whole, the firm, and the product level. We find that: (1) markups are relatively stable over time and mildly procyclical; (2) there is a large regional dispersion in markups; (3) there is a positive cross-sectional correlation between local income and local markups; and (4) differences in markups across regions result from differences in the assortment of goods sold i
socialSecurity.titleZh: 跨空间与时间的加成率研究
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文直接考察了零售行业加成率在空间和时间维度上的行为特征。加成率以毛利率来衡量。我们考虑了三个聚合层次：整个零售行业、企业层面以及产品层面。研究发现：（1）加成率随时间相对稳定，且呈轻度顺周期性；（2）加成率在区域间存在显著差异；（3）截面数据显示本地收入与本地加成率之间存在正相关关系；（4）区域间加成率的差异源于所销售商品种类的不同。

socialSecurity.title: A Robust Test for Weak Instruments for 2SLS with Multiple Endogenous Regressors
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe develop a test for instrument strength based on the bias of two-stage least squares (2SLS) that (1) generalizes Stock and Yogo’s and Sanderson and Windmeijer’s tests to be robust to heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation, and (2) extends Montiel Olea and Pflueger’s robust test for models with a single endogenous regressor to multiple endogenous regressors. Our test can be based either on an absolute bias criterion or on the 2SLS bias relative to a worst-case benchmark. We also develop extensions to test whether weak instruments cause bias in individual 2SLS coefficients. In simulati
socialSecurity.titleZh: 含多个内生回归变量2SLS弱工具变量的稳健检验
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们基于两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）的偏差开发了一种工具变量强度检验，该检验（1）将Stock与Yogo以及Sanderson与Windmeijer的检验推广为对异方差性和自相关具有稳健性，（2）将Montiel Olea与Pflueger针对单一内生回归变量模型的稳健检验扩展至多个内生回归变量情形。我们的检验既可基于绝对偏差准则，也可基于相对于最坏情况基准的2SLS偏差。此外，我们还开发了相应的扩展方法，用于检验弱工具变量是否导致单个2SLS系数出现偏差。在模拟中……

socialSecurity.title: The Economics of Equilibrium with Indivisible Goods
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis paper develops a theory of competitive equilibrium with indivisible goods based entirely on economic conditions on demand. The key idea is to analyze complementarity and substitutability between bundles of goods, rather than merely between goods themselves. This approach allows us to formulate sufficient and essentially necessary conditions for equilibrium existence—which unify settings with complements and settings with substitutes. Our analysis has implications for auction design.
socialSecurity.titleZh: 不可分物品均衡的经济学
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文基于对需求的纯粹经济条件，发展了一种关于不可分物品的竞争均衡理论。核心思想是分析商品束之间的互补性与替代性，而不仅仅是商品本身之间的互补性与替代性。该方法使我们能够提出关于均衡存在的充分且本质上必要的条件——这些条件统一了互补品情形与替代品情形。本分析对拍卖设计具有启示意义。

socialSecurity.title: Devaluations, Deposit Dollarization, and Household Heterogeneity
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe study the aggregate and redistributive effects of currency devaluations in a small open economy model with leverage-constrained banks and heterogeneous households. Our framework captures three stylized facts about financial dollarization in emerging economies: (1) a sizable share of domestic deposits is denominated in foreign currency; (2) these deposits represent significant foreign currency liabilities for local banks; and (3) dollar deposits are mainly held by wealthier households. A devaluation increases the real burden of foreign currency debt, causing an erosion of banks’ net
socialSecurity.titleZh: 货币贬值、存款美元化与家庭异质性
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们在一个含有杠杆约束银行和异质家庭的小型开放经济模型中，研究货币贬值的总量效应与再分配效应。该框架刻画了新兴经济体中金融美元化的三个典型事实：（1）国内存款中有相当大比例以外币计价；（2）这些存款对本地银行而言构成显著的外币负债；（3）美元存款主要由较富裕的家庭持有。货币贬值会增加外币债务的实际负担，从而侵蚀银行的净资产……

socialSecurity.title: Inflation Risk and the Finance-Growth Nexus
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWhen firms finance using long-term nominal debt issued by financial intermediaries, changes in expected inflation lead to a wealth transfer across sectors. Higher expected inflation decreases firms’ real liabilities and default risk, which helps reduce debt overhang. However, it hurts intermediaries’ real assets, leading to a contraction in credit supply. We theoretically demonstrate that intermediary financing conditions play a key role in the transmission of nominal shocks, influencing the premium investors require for bearing inflation risk. We provide empirical evidence supporting
socialSecurity.titleZh: 通货膨胀风险与金融-增长关系
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 当企业通过金融中介机构发行的长期名义债务进行融资时，预期通货膨胀率的变化会导致跨部门的财富转移。较高的预期通货膨胀率会降低企业的实际负债和违约风险，从而有助于缓解债务积压问题。然而，这会损害中介机构的实际资产，导致信贷供给收缩。我们从理论上证明，中介融资条件在名义冲击的传导中发挥着关键作用，影响投资者承担通货膨胀风险所要求的风险溢价。我们提供了支持该论点的经验证据。

socialSecurity.title: Bank Information Production Over the Business Cycle
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThe information banks produce drives their lending decisions and macroeconomic outcomes, but this information is inherently difficult to analyse because it is private. We construct a novel measure of bank information quality from confidential regulatory data that include banks’ private risk assessments for US corporate loans. Information quality improves as local economic conditions deteriorate, particularly for new loans, large loans, and loans with higher expected losses. Information quality also declines during periods of rapid local house price appreciation. Our results provide emp
socialSecurity.titleZh: 经济周期中的银行信息生产
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 银行所生产的信息驱动着其贷款决策与宏观经济结果，但该信息因本质上属于银行私有而难以分析。本文利用包含美国企业贷款银行私有风险评估的机密监管数据，构建了一种衡量银行信息质量的新指标。研究发现，在地方经济状况恶化时，银行信息质量有所提升，这一现象在新发放贷款、大额贷款以及预期损失较高的贷款中尤为明显。同时，在地方房价快速上涨时期，银行信息质量则出现下降。本文的结果为以下观点提供了经验支持...

socialSecurity.title: Costly Multidimensional Screening
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractA screening instrument is costly if it is socially wasteful and productive otherwise. A principal screens an agent with multidimensional private information and quasilinear preferences that are additively separable across two components: a one-dimensional productive component and a multidimensional costly component. Can the principal improve upon simple one-dimensional mechanisms by also using the costly instruments? We show that if the agent has preferences between the two components that are positively correlated in a suitably defined sense, then simply screening the productive compo
socialSecurity.titleZh: 成本高昂的多维甄别
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：若一种甄别工具具有社会浪费性，则其为高成本的；反之，若其具有生产性，则为低成本的。委托人针对具有多维私人信息的代理人进行甄别，代理人具有拟线性偏好，该偏好可在两个组成部分上可加分离：一维生产性组成部分与多维高成本组成部分。委托人能否通过同时使用高成本工具，改进简单的一维机制？我们证明，若代理人在两个组成部分之间的偏好以适当定义的意义呈正相关，那么仅对生产性组成部分进行甄别……

socialSecurity.title: Individualism and the Formation of Human Capital
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractMore individualistic countries experience higher economic growth. We provide evidence for a human-capital-based explanation of the growth effects of individualism. Using data from the largest international adult skill assessment, we establish that individualism shapes human capital formation. We identify the effects of individualism by exploiting variation between migrants at the origin-country, origin-language, and person level. Migrants from more individualistic cultures have higher cognitive skills and larger skill gains over time. They also invest more in their skills over the life
socialSecurity.source: Journal of the European Economic Association
socialSecurity.titleZh: 个人主义与人力资本的形成
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 更具个人主义倾向的国家往往实现更高的经济增长。本文为个人主义对增长的影响提供了基于人力资本的解释。借助全球最大规模的成人技能评估数据，我们证实个人主义塑造了人力资本的形成过程。我们通过利用移民在原籍国、原籍语言及个人层面的差异来识别个人主义的因果效应。来自更具个人主义文化背景的移民拥有更高的认知技能，并在随时间推移中实现更大的技能增长。他们在整个人生历程中也对自身技能进行了更多投资。

socialSecurity.title: Bridges
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractBridges are critical but sparse links in land transport networks. I exploit quasi-experimental variation in bridge construction over major rivers in the U.S. to measure the causal effects of land transport infrastructure. Bridges are more often built upstream than downstream of tributary confluences—where smaller rivers join larger rivers—generating local differences in connectivity. Local connectivity advantages have negative effects on per capita income. In contrast, more substantial changes in connectivity arising from the opening of major bridges increase per capita economic activi
socialSecurity.titleZh: 桥梁
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 桥梁是陆地运输网络中关键但分布稀疏的连接节点。本文利用美国主要河流上桥梁建设中的准实验变异，来度量陆地交通基础设施的因果效应。相较于支流汇合处下游，桥梁更常建于其上游——即较小河流汇入较大河流之处——由此产生了局部连通性差异。局部连通性优势对人均收入产生了负面影响。相比之下，由大型桥梁开通所带来的更显著的连通性提升，则增加了人均经济活动……（摘要原文在此处截断）

socialSecurity.title: Competition and loan contracting
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractA theoretical model of the borrower–lender relationship predicts that increased competitive threats lead to a reduction in loan covenant restrictiveness that is stronger for groups of borrowers who face constraints to their ability to raise external financing or compete in the product market. These predictions arise because competition impacts the dynamics of borrower performance so that lenders must trade off the benefit of controlling agency problems against a heightened cost of lost product market opportunities for the borrower, ultimately lowering the optimal use of covenants. We f
socialSecurity.titleZh: 竞争与贷款合同
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：关于借贷关系的理论模型预测，竞争威胁的增加会导致贷款契约限制性条款的减少，且对于在外部融资或产品市场竞争方面面临约束的借款人群组而言，这种减少效应更为显著。这些预测源于以下机制：竞争影响借款人业绩的动态变化，因此贷款人必须在控制代理问题所带来的收益与借款人因错失产品市场机会而增加的成本之间进行权衡，最终降低契约条款的最优使用程度。我们发

socialSecurity.title: Building Interpretable Climate Emulators for Economics
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe introduce a framework for developing efficient and interpretable climate emulators for economic models of climate change. The paper makes two main contributions. First, we propose a general framework for constructing carbon cycle emulators for macroeconomic models. The framework is implemented as a generalised linear multi-reservoir (box) model that conserves key physical quantities and can be customised for specific applications. We consider three versions of the carbon cycle emulator, which we evaluate within a simple representative agent economic model: (i) a three-box setting co
socialSecurity.titleZh: 为经济学构建可解释的气候模拟器
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们提出了一个为气候变化的经济模型开发高效且可解释的气候模拟器的框架。本文做出两项主要贡献。首先，我们提出了一个用于宏观经济学模型的碳循环模拟器构建的通用框架。该框架以一个守恒关键物理量且可针对特定应用进行定制的广义线性多储库（箱式）模型形式实现。我们考虑了碳循环模拟器的三个版本，并在一个简单的代表性经济主体经济模型中对其进行评估：(i) 一个三箱设置，...

socialSecurity.title: Inequality Along the European Green Transition
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThe EU aims for 42.5% green energy consumption by 2030. What are the effects of the European green transition on inequality? We answer this question using a heterogeneous-agent model with non-homothetic preferences for energy and non-energy goods, calibrated to European data. We study the impact of an increase in carbon taxes designed to meet the EU target under different revenue-recycling strategies. Redistributing tax revenues via uniform transfers reduces consumption inequality, shifts the welfare burden to high-income households, but leads to significant output losses. Subsidising
socialSecurity.titleZh: 欧洲绿色转型中的不平等问题
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 欧盟旨在到2030年实现42.5%的绿色能源消费目标。欧洲绿色转型对不平等有何影响？本文采用一个包含能源与非能源商品非位似偏好的异质性主体模型回答这一问题，并基于欧洲数据进行校准。我们研究了在不同税收收入循环策略下，为实现欧盟目标而提高碳税所产生的经济影响。通过统一转移支付的方式重新分配税收收入，能够降低消费不平等，并将福利负担转移至高收入家庭，但会带来显著的产出损失。对……的补贴（摘要不完整）

socialSecurity.title: Choice and Opportunity Costs
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe define the (physical) opportunity cost of a choice x as the alternative that would be chosen if x were not available, and the opportunity cost of any unchosen alternative as x itself. The agent has preferences over pairs consisting of alternatives and their opportunity costs. Because costs affect choice and vice-versa, choice results from an intrapersonal equilibrium rather than from simple maximisation. In spite of significant rationality assumptions, the resulting behaviour can be highly non-standard, allowing intransitive choices. Rational utility maximisation is ensured by an ad
socialSecurity.titleZh: 选择与机会成本
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要我们将某一选择 x 的（实质）机会成本定义为：若 x 不可获得，决策者将会选择的替代方案；而将任何未被选择的替代方案的机会成本定义为 x 本身。决策者对由替代方案与其机会成本所组成的配对具有偏好。由于成本影响选择，反之亦然，因此选择行为产生于一种人际内（intrapersonal）均衡，而非简单的最大化过程。尽管假设了相当强的理性条件，由此产生的行为仍可能高度偏离标准，甚至允许非传递性选择的发生。我们通过附加（ad）一个条件来确保理性的效用最大化。

socialSecurity.title: Policies for Early Childhood Skills Formation: Accounting for Parental Choices and Noncognitive Skills
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWhat are the returns in terms of children’s skills development to child allowance policies? Answering this question requires a theory of the trade-offs faced by households, as well as a realistic technology of skills formation. I build a model of parental choices that embeds the technology of cognitive and non-cognitive skills formation estimated by Cunha, Heckman, and Schennach (2010), featuring risky investment in children, time use trade-offs, idiosyncratic income risk, and borrowing constraints. Accounting for non-cognitive skills implies higher effectiveness of parental investment
socialSecurity.source: Journal of the European Economic Association
socialSecurity.titleZh: 儿童早期技能形成的政策：考虑父母选择与非认知技能
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：以儿童技能发展衡量，儿童津贴政策的回报是多少？回答这一问题需要一套关于家庭所面临权衡的理论，以及一个现实的技能形成技术。我构建了一个父母选择模型，该模型嵌入了Cunha、Heckman和Schennach（2010）所估计的认知与非认知技能形成技术，其特征包括对儿童的风险性投资、时间使用权衡、异质性收入风险以及借贷约束。将非认知技能纳入考量意味着父母投资具有更高的有效性。

socialSecurity.title: Deaths of Despair and the Decline of American Religion
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractIn recent decades, death rates from suicides, drug poisonings, and alcoholic liver disease have dramatically increased in the United States. We show that these “deaths of despair” began to increase relative to the trend in the early 1990s, that this increase was preceded by a decline in religious participation, and that both trends were driven by middle-aged white Americans. Using repeals of blue laws, we find that a shock to religious participation has significant effects on these mortality rates. Our findings show that social factors such as organized religion can play an important r
socialSecurity.source: Journal of the European Economic Association
socialSecurity.titleZh: 绝望之死与美国宗教的衰落
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 近几十年来，美国自杀、药物中毒和酒精性肝病的死亡率急剧上升。本文表明，这些"绝望之死"相对于长期趋势而言始于20世纪90年代初开始上升，而在此之前已出现宗教参与度的下降，并且这两种趋势均由中年美国白人所驱动。通过利用蓝法（blue laws）废止这一外生冲击，我们发现宗教参与的变动对这些死亡率具有显著影响。我们的发现表明，有组织宗教等社会因素能够发挥重要作用

socialSecurity.title: Firm Quality Dynamics and the Slippery Slope of Credit Intervention
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractA salient trend in crisis intervention has emerged in recent decades: government and central banks have offered funding directly to nonfinancial firms, bypassing banks and other credit intermediaries. We analyse the long-term consequences of such policies by focussing on firm quality dynamics. In a laissez-faire economy, firms with high productivity are more likely to survive crises than those with low productivity. The government funding support saves more firms but cannot be customized based on firm productivity, dampening the cleansing effect of crises. The policy distortion is self
socialSecurity.titleZh: 企业质量动态与信贷干预的滑坡效应
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 近几十年来，危机干预领域出现了一个显著趋势：政府与中央银行绕开银行及其他信贷中介机构，直接向非金融企业提供资金支持。本文聚焦于企业质量动态，分析此类政策的长期后果。在自由放任经济中，高生产率企业在危机中存活下来的概率高于低生产率企业。政府资金支持挽救了更多企业，但无法根据企业生产率进行差异化救助，从而削弱了危机的清退效应。这种政策扭曲具有自我强化特征……

socialSecurity.title: Venture capitalists versus deep-pocketed incumbents: startup financing strategies in the presence of competitive threats
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe examine how venture capitalists (VCs) adapt their financing strategies when investing in startups that compete against deep-pocketed incumbents. Employing textual analysis to identify a startup’s potential competitors, we show that when competitors are cash-rich, VCs deploy a financing strategy characterized by less conditionality, as observed through larger, less frequent funding rounds that are less contingent on short-term performance. This strategy requires VCs to rely more on continuous monitoring and liquidation protection, and is restricted to larger funds with specialized ex
socialSecurity.titleZh: 风险资本家对阵资金雄厚的在位企业：竞争威胁下的初创企业融资策略
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们考察了风险资本家（VC）在投资于与资金雄厚的在位企业相竞争的初创企业时，如何调整其融资策略。通过运用文本分析法来识别初创企业的潜在竞争对手，我们发现，当竞争对手现金充裕时，风险资本家会采用一种以较低约束性为特征的融资策略，表现为更大规模、更不频繁的融资轮次，且这些轮次对短期业绩的依赖性更低。该策略要求风险资本家更加依赖于持续监督和清算保护，并且仅限于拥有专业经验的大型基金采用。

socialSecurity.title: On the Fragility of Mediation: Theory and Experimental Evidence
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractMediation of disputes is increasingly common, often implemented by computer-run algorithms. We test the efficacy of a theoretically optimal mediation algorithm in an experiment where two subjects, uncertain about each other’s strength, negotiate how to share a resource. The subjects send cheap talk messages to one another (under direct communication) or to the computer mediator (under mediated communication) before expressing demands or receiving the mediator’s non-binding recommendation. While messages to the mediator are more sincere, we find that peaceful resolution is not more freq
socialSecurity.source: Journal of the European Economic Association
socialSecurity.titleZh: 论调解的脆弱性：理论与实验证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：纠纷调解正日益普遍，且常常由计算机算法来执行。我们在一个实验中对理论最优的调解算法的有效性进行了检验：在实验中，两名参与者在彼此不了解对方实力的情况下，就如何分享一项资源进行谈判。在提出各自诉求或收到调解者的非约束性建议之前，参与者可以向对方（在直接沟通条件下）或向计算机调解者（在调解沟通条件下）发送廉价交谈信息。我们发现，虽然发送给调解者的信息更为真诚，但和平解决并未更为频繁地出现。

socialSecurity.title: Life-Cycle Wages and Human Capital Investments: Selection and Missing Data
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe derive wage equations with individual-specific coefficients from a structural model of human capital investment over the life-cycle. This model allows for interruptions in labour market participation and deals with missing data and attrition problems. We propose a new framework that deals with missingness at random and is based on factor decompositions that allow for flexible control of selection. Our approach leads to an interactive effect wage specification, which we estimate using long administrative panel data on male wages in the private sector in France. A structural function
socialSecurity.titleZh: 生命周期工资与人力资本投资：选择与缺失数据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要：我们从生命周期人力资本投资的结构模型中推导出具有个体特定系数的工资方程。该模型允许劳动力市场参与出现中断，并处理缺失数据与样本流失问题。我们提出了一个新的框架，在随机缺失假设下处理缺失值问题，其基础是允许灵活控制选择性的因子分解方法。我们的方法导出了具有交互效应的工资设定形式，并利用法国私营部门男性工资的长期行政面板数据进行估计。结构函数……

socialSecurity.title: Diversification, Market Entry, and the Global Internet Backbone
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractIn many industries, buyers diversify their supplier base to manage supplier disruption risk. We investigate the importance of such diversification as a determinant of demand and supplier entry in the context of the internet backbone, the worldwide network of undersea fibre-optic cables that underpins the internet. We specify a model of international bandwidth demand and cable operators’ dynamic entry and supply choices. The model is estimated using novel data on cross-border data flows, prices, cable characteristics, and disruptions. Counterfactual analysis reveals that supplier divers
socialSecurity.titleZh: 多元化、市场进入与全球互联网骨干网
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 在许多行业中，买方会通过多元化其供应商基础来管理供应商中断风险。本文在互联网骨干网（即支撑全球互联网的海底光缆网络）的背景下，探讨此类多元化作为需求决定因素和供应商进入决定因素的重要性。我们构建了一个国际带宽需求以及电缆运营商动态进入与供给选择的模型，并使用跨境数据流量、价格、电缆特征及中断事件的新颖数据对模型进行估计。反事实分析表明，供应商多元化……

socialSecurity.title: Heterogeneous Oil Supply Elasticities: Indebtedness and Production Responses to the COVID-19 Shock
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractDebt matters for oil supply elasticities. We document the resiliency of oil production to the COVID-19-related collapse in demand due to indebtedness. We use exogenous variation in the timing of debt-related payments to identify financially constrained operators. We show that more financially constrained firms cut production by less than less-constrained firms and were less likely to complete new wells. To explore the mechanisms, we use borrowing-limit cuts and credit-line drawdowns to measure access to credit, and we exploit failed hedging practices. The propagation of oil demand shoc
socialSecurity.titleZh: 异质性石油供给弹性：债务与对新冠疫情冲击的生产响应
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 摘要 债务对石油供给弹性具有重要影响。本文记录了在新冠疫情导致需求崩溃的背景下，由于债务负担的存在，石油生产表现出了韧性。我们利用与债务相关的偿付时间外生变化来识别面临融资约束的经营主体。研究表明，融资约束程度较高的企业相比约束程度较低的企业削减产量更少，且更不可能完成新井的钻探。为探究其作用机制，我们使用借款限额削减和信贷额度提取来衡量企业的信贷获取能力，并利用失效的套期保值实践进行分析。石油需求冲击的传导……

socialSecurity.title: Optimal Climate Policy with Demographic Transitions
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis paper develops a framework to integrate demographic change into climate policy analysis. We build an overlapping-generations climate-economy model with a rich demographic structure, allowing population growth and survival probabilities to vary over time. These features endogenously determine the age composition of society and shape aggregate preferences. A central result of our framework is an aggregation result: despite the heterogeneity across cohorts, the planner’s problem can be recast as a representative-agent model with a time-varying social discount factor that reflects dem
socialSecurity.titleZh: 人口转型下的最优气候政策
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个将人口变化纳入气候政策分析的框架。我们建立了一个具有丰富人口结构特征的代际重叠气候-经济模型，允许人口增长率和存活概率随时间变动。这些特征内生地决定了社会的年龄构成，并塑造了总体偏好。本框架的一个核心结论是聚合定理：尽管各代之间存在异质性，决策者的问题可以重新表述为一个具有时变社会折现因子的代表性主体模型，该折现因子反映了人口结构。

socialSecurity.title: Interest-Based Negotiation over Natural Resources: Experimental Evidence from Liberia
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractWe experimentally evaluate whether an interest-based negotiation training for community leaders in Liberia improves their ability to strike beneficial deals related to their land and forests. We use environmental assessments, lab-in-the-field, and surveys and find that trainees are 27% more likely to reach a beneficial agreement, and it raises the total surplus earned by $2.74 USD, which is a 42% increase. Our exploration of mechanisms indicates that the training increases trainees’ capacity to identify valuable deals, but does not improve their appraisal of their outside option. We fi
socialSecurity.source: Journal of the European Economic Association
socialSecurity.titleZh: 基于利益的自然资源谈判：来自利比里亚的实验证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 我们通过实验方法评估了针对利比里亚社区领导者的基于利益的谈判培训，是否能够提升其就土地和森林议题达成有利协议的能力。我们综合运用环境评估、田野实验以及问卷调查，发现受训者达成有利协议的概率提高了27%，且其获得的总剩余增加了2.74美元，增幅达42%。在机制层面的探讨表明，该培训提升了受训者识别有价值协议的能力，但并未改善其对外部备选方案的评估。我们发现

socialSecurity.title: Fiscal Rules, Austerity in Public Administration, and Political Accountability: Evidence from a Natural Experiment in Colombia
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractFiscal rules are a popular tool to improve fiscal discipline and reduce waste in public spending, but their effectiveness and political feasibility remain unclear, particularly in weakly institutionalized settings. We leverage exogenous variation across Colombian municipalities in exposure to a fiscal rule that limits the operating expenditures of local governments. Our difference-in-differences analysis yields three main findings. First, the fiscal rule effectively reduces operating expenditures and the probability of a current deficit. Second, there is no meaningful impact on local p
socialSecurity.source: Journal of the European Economic Association
socialSecurity.titleZh: 财政规则、公共行政紧缩与政治问责：来自哥伦比亚自然实验的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 财政规则是改善财政纪律、减少公共支出浪费的常用工具，但其实施效果与政治可行性仍不明确，尤其是在制度薄弱的背景下。我们利用哥伦比亚各市政府在限制运营支出的财政规则上所面临的外生变异进行考察。基于双重差分方法，本文得出三项主要发现：第一，财政规则有效降低了地方政府的运营支出，并显著降低了出现当期赤字的概率；第二，对地方……

socialSecurity.title: Dodging Day Zero: Drought, Adaptation, and Inequality in Cape Town
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractA near-catastrophic drought in Cape Town, South Africa, illustrates three implications of climate change for publicly provided utility services. First, to reduce aggregate water demand, the public utility increased prices, leading to large demand reductions by richer households. Prior to the drought, they used twice the public piped water of poorer households. At the peak of the drought, they use less. Second, some of the differential demand reduction comes from richer households substituting away from public water toward privately financed groundwater. This private adaptation both low

socialSecurity.titleZh: 规避'零日'：开普敦的干旱、适应与不平等

socialSecurity.title: Bank market power and incentives for firm creation in innovative industries
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractI examine the role of banking competition for transmission of incentives to the creation of innovative firms. Exploiting the 2012 Start-Up Italy Act, designed to foster firm creation through public bank guarantees, I document that the policy increased the creation of innovative firms by 24 percent between 2012 and 2015, but only in provinces where banking competition is stronger. Weaker banking competition leads to less guaranteed lending, fewer venture capital deals and lower leverage for these firms, resulting in higher entrepreneurial migration. socialSecurity.titleZh: 银行市场力量与创新行业企业创建的激励
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文考察银行业竞争在向创新型企业创建传递激励方面的作用。利用2012年旨在通过公共银行担保促进企业创建的《意大利创业法案》，本文发现该政策在2012至2015年间使创新型企业的创建增加了24%，但这种效应仅出现在银行业竞争更为激烈的省份。银行业竞争较弱导致担保贷款减少、风险投资交易减少以及这些企业的杠杆率降低，进而引发更高的创业移民。研究结果表明，银行市场

socialSecurity.title: When Broadband Comes to Banks: Credit Supply, Market Structure, and Information Acquisition
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis paper studies how broadband internet affects bank credit supply to non-financial firms. We rely on loan-level data from the Italian Credit Register and quasi-experimental variation in the diffusion of broadband. Our estimates include firm-time fixed effects to control for the effect of broadband on firm demand. We find that branches in municipalities reached by fast internet increase loan supply and reduce interest rates. socialSecurity.titleZh: 宽带进入银行：信贷供给、市场结构与信息获取
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文研究宽带互联网如何影响银行对非金融企业的信贷供给。我们利用意大利信贷登记的贷款层面数据，以及宽带普及的准实验变异。我们的估计包含企业-时间固定效应，以控制宽带对企业需求的影响。研究发现，在接入高速互联网的市政区域内，银行分支机构会增加贷款供给并降低利率。高速互联网被用于在贷款发放后获取借款人的额外信息，从而改善贷款监督。这进而通过……（摘要截断）推动信贷扩张。

socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractIn “Immigration, search and redistribution: A quantitative assessment of native welfare,” a paper by Battisti et al. published in the August 2018 issue of the Journal of the European Economic Association, the authors inquire about how migration to 20 Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) countries affects the welfare of the countries’ native workers. In this comment, we raise several concerns regarding the analytical and the empirical parts of the Battisti et al.’s inquiry that bear on this effect. socialSecurity.titleZh: 移民、搜寻与再分配：本土福利的定量评估（评论）
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 在Battisti等人发表在2018年8月《欧洲经济协会杂志》上的论文《移民、搜寻与再分配：本土福利的定量评估》中，作者探究了向20个经济合作与发展组织（OECD）国家的移民如何影响这些国家本土工人的福利。在本评论中，我们对Battisti等人研究中涉及该影响的分析部分和实证部分提出了若干担忧。特别是，当Battisti等人就某种划分规则进行表述时……

socialSecurity.title: Bank specialization and corporate innovation
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractTheory offers conflicting predictions on how bank specialization affects corporate innovation. We show that the sign and magnitude of this effect vary with the degree of “asset overhang” across sectors—the risk that new technologies reduce the value of banks’ legacy loan portfolios. Using Belgian innovation survey data and US patent data, we find that lenders’ sectoral specialization enhances innovation for firms operating in sectors with low asset overhang, but hinders innovation in sectors with high asset overhang. These findings are robust to different measures of asset overhang and
socialSecurity.titleZh: 银行专业化与公司创新
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 理论界关于银行专业化如何影响企业创新存在相互冲突的预测。本文表明，该影响的符号与大小因不同行业的"资产悬置"程度而异——所谓资产悬置，是指新技术可能降低银行遗留贷款组合价值所带来的风险。利用比利时创新调查数据和美国专利数据，本文发现：在资产悬置程度较低的行业，贷款人的行业专业化能够促进企业创新；而在资产悬置程度较高的行业，则会抑制企业创新。上述结论在不同资产悬置度量方式下依然稳健。

socialSecurity.title: When in Doubt, Tax More Progressively? Uncertainty and Progressive Income Taxation
socialSecurity.abstract: ABSTRACTWe study the optimal income tax problem under parameter uncertainty about household preferences and wage dynamics. We derive conditions characterizing how such uncertainty affects optimal tax policy. To quantify the effect, we estimate a life‐cycle model using US data and a Bayesian approach. Parameter uncertainty makes the optimal tax more progressive, increasing the marginal tax rate gap between high‐ and low‐income households by 5.5 percentage points. This effect is primarily driven by uncertainty about the wage process. We also find that parameter uncertainty imposes sizable welfare costs through the income tax channel alone.

socialSecurity.title: Paying off the competition: contracting, market power, and innovation incentives
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractThis article explores the relationship between a firm’s legal contracting environment and its innovation incentives. Using granular data from the pharmaceutical industry, we examine a contracting mechanism through which incumbents maintain market power: “pay-for-delay” agreements to delay the market entry of competitors. Exploiting a shock where such contracts become legally tenuous, we find that affected incumbents subsequently increase their innovation activity across a variety of project-level measures. socialSecurity.titleZh: 收买竞争者：合同、市场势力与创新激励
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文探讨了企业法律合同环境与其创新激励之间的关系。利用制药行业的细粒度数据，我们考察了一种在位企业维持市场势力的合同机制：通过"付费延迟"协议来延迟竞争对手进入市场。利用此类合同在法律上变得不确定这一外生冲击，我们发现受影响的在位企业随后在多种项目层面的指标上增加了创新活动。在探究这种创新的性质时，我们还发现它更具"影响力"……

socialSecurity.title: On the Geographic Implications of Carbon Taxes
socialSecurity.abstract: AbstractUsing a multi-sector dynamic spatial integrated assessment model, we argue that a carbon tax introduced by the European Union and rebated locally can, if not too large, increase the size of Europe’s economy by concentrating economic activity in its high-productivity non-agricultural core and by incentivising immigration to the European Union. The resulting change in the spatial distribution of economic activity improves global efficiency and welfare. A carbon tax introduced by the United States generates similar effects. This stands in sharp contrast with standard models that ignore tr
socialSecurity.titleZh: 论碳税的地缘经济影响
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 本文运用多部门动态空间综合评估模型，论证欧盟开征碳税并予以本地返还，只要税率不致过高，便可通过将经济活动集中于其高生产率的非农核心区域，并激励移民流入欧盟，从而扩大欧盟经济规模。由此带来的经济活动空间分布变化能够提升全球效率与福利。美国开征碳税亦会产生类似效应。这与那些忽略[文本截断]的标准模型形成鲜明对比。

socialSecurity.abstract: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3197-3222 Abstract Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children's adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an undersupply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children's future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. socialSecurity.titleZh: 主席演讲：邻里效应与机会的失灵市场
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 实验与准实验研究表明，儿童时期的邻里环境对其成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著因果影响。多种市场失灵很可能导致按父母收入划分的居住过度分化，以及混合收入社区的供给不足。机会的失灵市场源于借贷子女未来收益时的资本市场不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜索摩擦。定制化住房流动性（原文未完）

socialSecurity.title: Contextually Private Mechanisms
socialSecurity.abstract: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3223-3262 Abstract A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations—information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. socialSecurity.titleZh: 情境隐私机制
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 《美国经济评论》第116卷第9期，第3223-3262页。摘要：设计者采用动态协议来引出私人信息。协议会产生一组情境隐私违反——即在给定情境下可能属于多余的信息。如果不存在其他协议在实施同一选择规则的前提下产生其违反集的一个真子集，则该协议是最大情境隐私的。当一个选择规则使某些代理人集体（而非个体）成为关键投票人时，情境隐私违反便会产生。在拍卖中，为情境隐私进行设计需要在初步分配中选择一个……（摘要截断）

socialSecurity.title: Manipulation-Robust Prediction
socialSecurity.abstract: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3263-3293 Abstract An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress-test this approach through a large field experiment
socialSecurity.titleZh: 抗操纵性预测
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 《美国经济评论》第116卷第9期，第3263–3293页。摘要：越来越多的决策由机器学习算法指导。然而，当重大决策被编码在算法中时，个体可能策略性地改变其行为以获得期望的结果。本文开发了一种经验方法，通过调整决策算法来预判操纵行为。通过对操纵激励进行显式建模，我们的方法所生成的决策规则即使在完全透明的情况下也能在操纵下保持稳定。我们通过一项大规模实地实验对该方法进行了压力测试。

socialSecurity.abstract: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3294-3329 Abstract Efficient risk sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). socialSecurity.titleZh: 风险分担检验与共同冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪水与虫害
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 《美国经济评论》116 (9): 3294-3329 摘要：有效的风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUE）具有简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以一个共同价格。标准方法从总支出中推断MUE，隐含地假设了同质偏好、单位收入弹性以及相同的价格弹性。使用总支出进行的风险分担检验对于异质冲击（预算变化但价格不变）有效，但对于"共同"冲击（价格变化）无效。本文描述了所有允许从支出和估计...

socialSecurity.title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World's Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
socialSecurity.abstract: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3330-3379 Abstract Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait-time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. socialSecurity.titleZh: 公共交通网络优化：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 《美国经济评论》第116卷第9期，第3330-3379页。摘要：公共交通网络的设计需要在覆盖范围、服务频率和直达服务之间进行权衡。本文利用印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩展来研究这些权衡。我们分析新的直达连接、公交车行驶时间变化以及候车时间缩短如何影响公交乘客量和总流量，并通过匹配线路开通事件来估计一个交通网络需求模型。结果显示，雅加达通勤者对候车时间的敏感度是对乘车时间的2-3倍，且对长距离绕行缺乏关注。我们开发了一种灵活的……（摘要不完整）

socialSecurity.title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers' Earnings
socialSecurity.abstract: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3380-3422 Abstract We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in US history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their preexisting legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms' investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. socialSecurity.titleZh: 企业减税、企业增长与工人收入
socialSecurity.abstractZh: 《美国经济评论》第116卷第9期：3380-3422。摘要：我们研究美国历史上最大规模的企业所得税削减对企业和工人的影响。为识别因果效应，我们使用雇主与雇员匹配的税务记录，并采用事件研究方法，比较同一行业中规模相似但因既有法律地位不同而面临不同税收变化的企业。减税带来了企业投资、销售、利润、就业及工资总额的增加，且收入增长集中在高薪酬工人群体中。短期内，私人收入增量的87%流向了收入分布前10%的群体。

Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic-group-specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching. socialSecurity.titleZh: 意大利的婚姻、生育与文化融合

I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online health care, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4 percent (SE 1.3); reallocations also reduce Counter-Guideline antibiotics by 3.1 percent (1.4).
